posts.body:
hi! nice to meet you!
I used RPG Maker 2000 when I was young. This story is already over 20 years old. It's been a while since I was thinking about old times, so I bought mz, mv, and vx on steam. (Some are for resource reference only.)
I don't know if they will make games in the future, but it was worth purchasing because it is a tool of my memories.
Happy day everyone!
